provenance.exact_claim_text: A population parameter changes substantially over a defined period.

evidence.text: Source A reports a baseline quantity X.
Source B reports a change rate Y.
Inspektorium combines X and Y with a documented simplified model to estimate the aggregate change.
evidence.derivation_note: Modelled estimate: aggregate = f(X, Y) under model M. Not a value reported by any cited source.

findings.proposition: The substantial-change claim rests partly on an Inspektorium modelled estimate, not a directly source-reported value.
findings.verdict_summary: Two source-reported inputs (E1, E2) feed one Inspektorium derived estimate (D1). The claim is not directly established by any single source-reported value.

client_findings.display_claim: The reviewed sources report a baseline quantity and a change rate; the aggregate figure is an Inspektorium modelled estimate.
client_findings.client_explanation: Two values are taken directly from the cited sources. The aggregate change is an Inspektorium estimate derived from those inputs under a simplified model, not a value published by any source.
